question: Which of the following organisations was founded by Vinayak Damodar Savarkar in 1904?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinav Bharat Society**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abhinav Bharat Society** was a secret society founded by Vinayak Damodar Savarkar in 1904.
 
• The society was initially named **Mitra Mela** before being renamed to Abhinav Bharat Society in 1906.
 
• It aimed at promoting revolutionary activities to overthrow British rule in India through armed rebellion.
 
• The society played a significant role in the Indian independence movement, inspiring many young revolutionaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar**

 
 
• Vinayak Damodar Savarkar, commonly known as Veer Savarkar, was an Indian independence activist, politician, lawyer, writer, and the formulator of the Hindutva philosophy.
 
• He was born on May 28, 1883, in Bhagur, a village near Nashik in Maharashtra.
 
• He was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement and was known for his radical views and activities against British rule.
 
• He was arrested in 1909 by the British authorities for his involvement in revolutionary activities and sentenced to life imprisonment in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
 
 
• **Jugantar**
 
 
• Jugantar was a Bengali revolutionary organization that operated in the early 20th century against British rule.
 
• It was a part of the larger Anushilan Samiti and was involved in various revolutionary activities, including armed attacks and bombings.
 
 
 
• **Indian Independence League**
 
 
• The Indian Independence League was a political organization formed in 1927 in India and overseas to organize and promote the Indian independence movement.
 
• It played a crucial role during World War II in collaboration with the Indian National Army (INA) led by Subhas Chandra Bose.
 
 
 
• **Free India Society**
 
 
• The Free India Society was an organization formed by Indian students in England in the early 20th century to promote the cause of Indian independence.
 
• It was associated with prominent Indian leaders like Lala Lajpat Rai, Mahatma Gandhi, and V. D. Savarkar.
